name: Force YAML keys to be escaped with double quotes where not already escaped with `Force YAML escape on keys = 'key'\n'title'\n'bool'`
before:
---
key: 'Already escaped value'
title: This is a title
bool: false
unaffected: value
---

_Note that the force YAML key option should not be used with arrays._
after:
---
key: 'Already escaped value'
title: "This is a title"
bool: "false"
unaffected: value
---

_Note that the force YAML key option should not be used with arrays._
